completed.name: reference_setup
completed.notes: Continued existing .blend. Classified all nine references, aligned primary images, measured proportions, normalized height to 1 m, created four orthographic cameras. Geometry retained.

completed.name: silhouette_blockout
completed.notes: Fitted the saved silhouette to measured front and side sections; increased posterior skull volume, adjusted cheek depth and body widths while retaining topology and T-pose.

completed.name: production_topology
completed.notes: Converted the existing continuous body to an editable positive-X half with clipping Mirror before Subdivision 2. Preserved deformation loops and reference-like quad flow.

completed.name: face_and_ears
completed.notes: Fitted shallow radial eye surfaces behind eyelids, refined rolled helix/concha/tragus in existing ear loops, and continued posterior skull curvature through the crown. Head mesh retained.

completed.name: hands_and_feet
completed.notes: Replaced only hand geometry beyond the existing wrist. Built four separately articulated fingers plus a short rounded thumb, connected through a quad palm and webs; Mirror supplies the opposite hand. Feet retained after silhouette comparison.

completed.name: validation_comparison
completed.notes: Compared measured widths and all orthographic views. Validation identified isolated vertices, eight non-quad cage faces from the symmetry cut and four cage intersection pairs; the subdivided surface is closed without self-intersections. These local control-mesh issues are recorded for milestone 7 cleanup.

completed.name: final_cleanup
completed.notes: Removed isolated vertices, converted symmetry-cut triangles to quads with centerline support points, separated thumb/palm and cheek/socket cage faces, recalculated normals, refreshed UVs and set the evaluated height to exactly 1 m with soles at Z=0.
